Figures describe the Avoriaz sector. Search summary of avoriaz.com and guides: 35 lifts and 54 slopes (8 green, 27 blue, 14 red, 6 black — adds to 55); 4 snowparks and a boardercross; mostly chairlifts with 'just a couple of drag lifts' (counts by type not given). Another guide: 36 lifts, 49 slopes (4/26/14/6). Avoriaz's own piste km and capacity not found. Linked Portes du Soleil: 600 km, 209 lifts, 308 slopes, 12 resorts in France and Switzerland (Wikipedia: more than 650 km and about 200 lifts).

Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Ski schools and rental shops operate in the resort. Avoriaz is car-free (reference)

character: Avoriaz is a car-free, ski-in/ski-out resort at about 1,800 m above Morzine, built in distinctive wood-clad architecture. Its own sector has about 35 lifts and 54 runs, and it sits at the centre of the Portes du Soleil, which links 12 resorts across France and Switzerland (about 600 km of pistes and 209 lifts).
learning: The Avoriaz sector has 8 green and 27 blue runs (search summary). Reference: beginner areas are in the village; confirm beginner-lift access and lessons for 2026-27.
